observed_context: The only matched python PID was the preflight process itself.
Normal desktop processes held Intel card1 device handles.
Feishu held Intel renderD128 handles at snapshot time.
interpretation_limits: An open DRM device handle does not prove active GPU load.
The desktop GPU context is recorded, not treated as a fault cause.
Historical Phase 3 evidence did not preserve equivalent per-process DRM ownership, so exact workload equivalence cannot be claimed.
decision: Allow the frozen Stage 2A Round 1 run without changing the captured desktop context.
